integrity: The theorem is proved from the Prüfer bijection, Stirling row real-rootedness, and a one-crossing argument. No external or independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Finite-size conditional order for a single marked vertex in uniform labeled trees only. Classical leaf-count and degree enumerations are not new; historical occupancy total-positivity literature could imply an equivalent ordering. General proof supplied; finite verification is supplementary.
title: Leaf-conditioned convex ordering of a marked degree in uniform Cayley trees
